name: Capuchin Caverns
summary:
Capuchin Caverns is a multiplayer monkey game where you can hang out, monkey around, and buy cosmetics. 
⚪ Explore 3 levels of terrifying horror
⚪ Jump on parkour obstacle courses and super bouncy trampolines
⚪ Play tag inside an ever-changing forest and village
⚪ Do an explosive, roller coaster train ride
⚪ A trick glass bridge with glass stepping stones
⚪ Fly around hoops in the Flying Room
⚪ Do much more and enjoy the adventure with other monkeys!
